goal: Evolve FRANK memory/state into an associative semantic substrate without sacrificing exact truth, latency-critical state, authority boundaries, replay or rollback.
global_invariants: No destructive DB removal before parity/replay/crash gates.
Graph activation never becomes current-state or capability authority.
Exact event/state writes remain single-authority until an explicitly proven replacement exists.
Every cutover retains a rollback window and legacy read path.

actions: On live FRANK host enumerate all 71 DB files read-only: path,size,mtime,journal/WAL,schema/table/index counts.
Static service->DB reference scan plus runtime lsof sampling to classify readers/writers.
Classify each store/table as exact authority, event log, derived projection/cache, semantic memory, queue, safety/capability, external mirror or unknown.
Record privacy and backup/recovery behavior without exporting sensitive rows.
phases.gate: 100% of current stores have evidence-backed disposition or explicit UNKNOWN with owner/test.

actions: Define stable semantic identities and exact-anchor witnesses for entities/events/state records.
Map temporal validity, transaction/revision time, provenance, supersession/conflict and n-ary relations.
Specify projection rules in ClayCode; keep physical topology separate from semantic topology.
phases.gate: Round-trip fixtures preserve identity/status/provenance for representative records including stale/conflict/revoked cases.

actions: Build ClayGraph from read-only snapshots/changefeeds into separate storage.
No FRANK decisions consume shadow graph.
Record source lag, source revision and rebuildability for every assertion.
phases.gate: No source write path altered; deterministic rebuild matches semantic hashes.

actions: Compare legacy SQL/direct reads vs ClayGraph on current, historical, contradiction and multi-hop query sets.
Replay recorded workspace/memory episodes with graph enabled only as observer.
Inject stale, conflicting, revoked and missing dependencies.
Measure p50/p95/p99, memory, update amplification, exact-anchor misses and crash recovery.
phases.gate: No exact-answer parity regressions on required classes; false-association threshold preregistered; recovery equivalence demonstrated.

actions: M.MEMORY_FABRIC reads both legacy stores and ClayGraph; graph result logged but legacy remains decision source.
Compare candidate assemblies, token cost and downstream answer/task deltas.
Require exact anchor fetch for current-state/authority-sensitive content.
phases.gate: Target benefit replicated on held-out queries and no safety/consistency regressions.

actions: For semantic memory with a single authoritative event/record contract, write authority first and project graph asynchronously with receipt/lag marker.
Do not dual-write safety/capability authority or hot exact state without an atomic/outbox contract.
Detect projection divergence continuously.
Allow ClayGraph to become primary associative retrieval path inside M.MEMORY_FABRIC only for store/table classes with passed gates.
Keep CognitiveFrame exact state, CapabilityGateway/K0 authority and latency-critical reflex state outside associative authority.
Preserve fallback direct SQL/exact fetch.
phases.gate: p99, accuracy, replay and resource budgets pass target hardware test.
phases.rollback: Switch retrieval policy to legacy/direct; graph remains derived.

actions: Run legacy and graph parity checks for a defined observation period.
Retain pre-cutover backups/schema readers and deterministic rebuild scripts.
Audit semantic hashes/evidence ancestry.
phases.gate: No unresolved high-severity divergence through window.
phases.rollback: Restore legacy read policy and authoritative stores; discard/rebuild projections.

actions: Only remove redundant derived caches/indexes if no unique authority/recovery/history role remains.
Keep isolated conventional stores where transactions, hot path latency, security or external protocol semantics dominate.
Document permanent LINK/KEEP_ISOLATED boundaries as intentional architecture.
phases.rollback: Restore preserved schema/data if deprecation gate had allowed removal.

consciousness.db.reason: mixed exact/history + semantic cognition; cross-process workspace bridge is latency measured and remains authoritative during migration

world_experience.db.reason: slow exact personality state can anchor semantic trends without losing calibrated values

thalamus_runtime_store.disposition: DEFER -> likely LINK/KEEP_ISOLATED hot exact state
thalamus_runtime_store.reason: current identity/schema unknown and request-path latency sensitive

invariants_historical.disposition: DEFER -> KEEP_ISOLATED if current authority store
invariants_historical.reason: safety invariant authority cannot be delegated to model-visible activation
